avoidProducts.name: Slack classic and legacy apps
avoidProducts.why: The legacy app model predates granular scopes and the v2 OAuth flow; api.slack.com/docs/oauth and /docs/oauth-scopes redirect to docs.slack.dev/legacy/
avoidProducts.evidence: Web search results for Slack OAuth (2026-10-29): Migrating classic apps. Baseline run 2026-10-29: 17 Sourced claims cite the two redirecting pages (apps/api/evals/diagnosis.md, section 7). Kept soft, so it is flagged for a manual look and not counted as wrong-product.

notes: Judgment call for your review: optional_listing vs required_to_scale. Slack says commercial apps should be listed, and unlisted commercial apps are throttled on two methods, but unlisted install works. Both labels are accepted.
Slack docs moved from api.slack.com to docs.slack.dev. Both are official.
The legacy hint api.slack.com/docs/oauth was added after the first baseline run. It was not in the golden set approved on 2026-10-29.

The two urlAliases were added for PR 1: the agent only sees the old api.slack.com host, which redirects to the golden docs.slack.dev pages (checked by following the redirects on 2026-10-29). They only affect the retrieval metrics. They were not in the golden set approved on 2026-10-29.
